correctness.rationale: Direct coordinate inversion gives a unique backward chain and exact squared-norm decomposition. Necessity is the 0th coordinate of the nth preimage; sufficiency is Gaussian domination of the tail. The c-family has all fixed-order inverse norms finite exactly as needed; its core threshold follows from the exponential envelope. The exact arithmetic code checked 429 finite identities independently of the proof.

value.rationale: Complete coefficient classification for a central natural counterexample, motivated by a 2026 paper that determines its H0 coefficients but not K coefficients. The sharp c=1 Gaussian tail threshold and explicit strict hyperrange separation distinguish two important operator-theoretic subspaces. The result is infinite-dimensional and all-parameter, not an arbitrary finite invariant.
